Package edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller

Class ApplicantRecruitmentsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApplicantRecruitmentsController
@RequestMapping("/api/recruitments") @RestController public class ApplicantRecruitmentsController extends ApiController
What an applicant needs to know about recruitments: whether they can apply now, when a past one ran, and when an upcoming one is expected to open.

Every response is filtered to the type the current user may apply to, so a grad student is never shown a ULA recruitment and vice versa. That filtering happens here rather than in the page, so it cannot be bypassed.
